name: Physical Grammar Hypothesis
notes: Umbrella speculative hypothesis family; not an accepted physical framework.

name: Weak PGH
notes: Physical possibility exhibits grammatical structure; too weak by itself to establish the strong program.

name: Strong PGH
notes: Fundamental physical law is identified with a compact representation-independent generative grammar rather than an additional law set.

name: Linguistic-Physical Identity Hypothesis
notes: Stronger identity conjecture; no claim about contingent human-language syntax is established.

name: DISTINGUISH
notes: Superseded as an independent object-level primitive at bare formation well-formedness scope; grammar-internal distinction is induced by formation profile.

name: COMPOSE
notes: Superseded as a privileged binary fundamental primitive; PGH-0 retains only the need for some abstract formation/generative mechanism.

name: IDENTIFY
notes: Superseded as an independent object-level primitive at bare formation well-formedness scope; contextual equivalence is induced by formation profile.

name: DCI minimal grammar candidate
notes: Opening {DISTINGUISH, COMPOSE, IDENTIFY} shell; superseded by PGH-GRAM-0002 after PGH-0 minimality adjudication.

name: Extensional Formation Baseline
notes: Provisional nonphysical baseline: carrier plus formation relation with contextual extensional quotient. Fails nontrivial physical sufficiency.

name: Contextual Extensional Reduction
notes: Qualified formal result at bare formation well-formedness scope; no physical consequence.

name: Bare Formation Grammar Physical Sufficiency Failure
notes: Preserved failure: arbitrary formation tables encode arbitrary local admissibility and do not yield nontrivial selection.

name: Isomorphism Covariance Underdetermination
notes: Qualified formal result: relabeling covariance removes label dependence but leaves arbitrary selection among isomorphism classes.

name: Parse Coherence Implies Associativity
notes: Qualified conditional formal result: parenthesization-independence forces associativity in total deterministic binary representations; premise not yet earned.

name: Strong Permutation Invariance as Label Neutrality Failure
notes: Preserved failure: full permutation automorphy is substantive homogeneity, not mere covariance under renaming.

name: Unprivileged Simplicity Selection Failure
notes: Preserved failure: raw description length cannot select a formation law before a privileged or invariant description framework is justified.
